description: Free: the green/orange/red verdict only, for a transaction, token approval, EIP-712 signature, XRP Ledger transaction (type xrpl) Algorand transaction (type algorand) or Stellar transaction (type stellar) your agent is about to sign. Limited to 10 calls per hour. For the reason codes and details use presign_check ($0.01); for a plain-language explanation presign_check_explain ($0.03).

address.description: authorization: the contract the EIP-7702 authorization delegates the wallet to (0x0…0 clears a delegation). Any delegation hands the contract the whole wallet: orange EIP7702_AUTHORIZATION unless the contract is on GoPlus's trust list; red AUTHORIZATION_TO_NO_CONTRACT, AUTHORIZATION_TO_UNVERIFIED_CONTRACT, AUTHORIZATION_TO_FLAGGED_CONTRACT, SANCTIONED_ADDRESS

amount.description: approval: amount in base units (0 = revoke)

authorizationChainId.description: authorization, optional: the chain id inside the authorization, chainId (default) or 0 = valid on every chain (orange AUTHORIZATION_ALL_CHAINS)

chainId.description: EVM chain id, required for approval, transaction, signature and authorization: 1, 10, 56, 137, 196, 8453, 42161, 4663, 43114 (8453 = Base); optional for message

from.description: transaction, message or authorization, optional: your wallet address (authorization: its current delegation is shown); the transaction is then simulated (what really leaves and arrives; orange HIDDEN_APPROVAL, SIMULATION_NFT_OUT, SIMULATION_FAILS) and its recipients are compared with who this wallet paid before (red ADDRESS_POISONING for a look-alike)

intent.description: optional: what you are trying to do, in one sentence (e.g. "swap 10 USDC for ETH on Uniswap"); orange INTENT_MISMATCH when signing would do more or something else

message.description: message: the text or 0x-hex about to be signed; a Sign-In with Ethereum message for another site than origin is red, unreadable bytes are orange

method.description: message: how it is signed (default personal_sign); eth_sign is always red

network.description: xrpl: xrpl:0 (mainnet, default) or xrpl:1 (testnet); stellar: stellar:pubnet (default) or stellar:testnet

origin.description: optional: the site asking for the signature or transaction (URL or hostname); a domain under 30 days old is orange

transaction.description: solana: the base64 wire transaction about to be signed; decoded and simulated (red SOLANA_TOKEN_ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER, SOLANA_ACCOUNT_ASSIGN; orange SOLANA_UNLIMITED_DELEGATE, SOLANA_DURABLE_NONCE, HIDDEN_APPROVAL, SIMULATION_FAILS). algorand: one base64 msgpack transaction (unsigned or signed); red ALGORAND_REKEY, ALGORAND_CLOSE_ACCOUNT, ALGORAND_ASSET_CLOSE, ALGORAND_FAKE_STABLECOIN; simulated. stellar: a base64 XDR transaction envelope (unsigned, signed or a fee bump, as an x402 payment on Stellar); red STELLAR_ACCOUNT_MERGE, STELLAR_SIGNER_ADDED, STELLAR_MASTER_KEY_DISABLED, STELLAR_FAKE_STABLECOIN, ADDRESS_POISONING; orange STELLAR_TOKEN_APPROVE, STELLAR_HIDDEN_APPROVE, STELLAR_MEMO_REQUIRED; Soroban calls simulated.

transactions.description: algorand: an atomic group, each a base64 msgpack transaction; send the whole group so every transaction is checked

tx.description: xrpl: the unsigned transaction JSON (TransactionType, Account, Destination, Amount, …), including CredentialCreate, CredentialAccept, DelegateSet, Batch (every inner transaction is judged), vault deposits and withdrawals (VaultDeposit, VaultWithdraw) and loans (LoanSet, LoanPay)

type.description: What the agent is about to sign; authorization = an EIP-7702 authorization delegating the wallet to the contract in address; message = a plain personal_sign / eth_sign message in message; solana = a Solana transaction in transaction; xrpl = an unsigned XRP Ledger transaction in tx; algorand = an Algorand transaction in transaction, or a group in transactions; stellar = a Stellar transaction envelope in transaction

typedData.description: signature: the exact eth_signTypedData_v4 payload (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009 x402 payment, Seaport)

x402.description: optional, EIP-3009 payments only: the x402 payment requirements you are paying ({ accepted: { scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, extra } }, one entry of the 402's accepts); red when the signature pays more, someone else, another token or chain

name: presign_quick_check

verdict.description: green: go ahead; orange: ask the user; red: do not sign or buy

title: Quick pre-sign verdict (free)
